title: Longest Valid Parentheses
statement:
Given a string containing just the characters '(' and ')', find the length of the longest valid (well-formed) parentheses substring.

A stack can be used to keep track of indices of invalid characters, allowing you to find lengths of valid sections between them.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest valid parentheses substring.
